# Bootstrap 5.3.3

Vendored unmodified for kiosk operation without internet access.

- CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- JavaScript bundle (includes Popper): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twbs/bootstrap/v5.3.3/LICENSE

The MIT license is included in LICENSE. Source maps referenced in upstream comments are optional development aids and are not bundled. Update both assets together and retain the license.
